_comment: Accepted codegen-differential defects, per (component, attribute, platform, check). An entry means the converter demonstrably fails that judgement and the failure is accepted FOR A STATED REASON — not that it is fine. Unrecorded defects fail `jui conformance gate --codegen-effect`; entries the measurement no longer supports are stale and fail too, so fixing a defect forces its row out (the one-directional version lets a fixed row sit here forever, which is how the previous freeze ledgers rotted). Advisory classes (value-is-default, numeric-string-divergence) are re-derived every run and are deliberately absent. Reason 'unreviewed-initial-measurement' marks the initial-measurement backlog — consume it.
